versions.subject: feat: new findstr rule for passwords recon (#4251)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\findstr.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'FINDSTR.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'contraseña' # Spanish
        - 'hasło' # Polish
        - 'heslo' # Czech
        - 'parola' # Italian
        - 'passe' # French
        - 'passw' # German, English
        - 'senha' # Portuguese
        - 'senord' # Swedish
        - '密碼' # Cantonese
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\findstr.exe" OR OriginalFileName="FINDSTR.EXE" CommandLine IN ("*contraseña*", "*hasło*", "*heslo*", "*parola*", "*passe*", "*passw*", "*senha*", "*senord*", "*密碼*")
